description: Mapping packs for tailwind-merge 3.7.0 and tailwind-variants 3.3.1 (docs/design/M6-LIBRARIES.md), evaluated at build time by the real packages: shadcn's cn (twMerge(clsx(inputs)), inlined), twMerge and twJoin with constant arguments, with `cond && 'x'`, conditionals, arrays and clsx objects; tv variant functions with literal-union state (default and explicit variants, undefined size), a conditional variant, `a || b` over a nullable union, a boolean variant, compound variants and a constant `class`; the merged classes in class attributes (styled by hand-written stand-ins for a few utilities) and as text
